about:
All Electric Supply Inc. is a third-generation, family-owned electrical distributor founded in 1957 by Roy T. Beard Jr. in Little Rock, Arkansas. The company began as a local supplier for contractors and builders in central Arkansas.

The firm stocks and distributes a broad range of electrical products, including Maxlite LED lamps, GE ballasts and fluorescent lamps, Eaton and Cutler-Hammer breakers, Cooper wiring devices, and EMT, PVC, and Sealtite connectors. It operates a will-call counter and offers local delivery, while its sales staff provides technical troubleshooting and helps source specialty items not kept in stock.

All Electric Supply primarily serves regional electrical contractors, builders, and commercial facilities. The company is also a Trade Ally for Entergy’s Commercial Energy Efficiency Programs, assisting commercial customers with energy-saving upgrades.

The company differentiates itself with a triple guarantee: will-call orders ready in 45 minutes or less, 100 percent order accuracy, and local delivery within 24 hours. Its heritage, tracing back to the founder’s ancestor Nanyehi (Nancy Ward), a Cherokee leader, is cited as a cultural touchstone for stewardship and cooperation.
